name: Secret-exposure blast-radius trace with owner-gated rotation
description: BP-SEC-02 (card 62). Defining mechanism: a single exposed credential is traced across EVERY surface class in parallel - working trees, git history, index entries, logs, artifacts and remotes - and the parallel results are reconciled into ONE exposure set in which an unsearchable surface is recorded as UNSEARCHED rather than assumed clean. Deletion is explicitly not remediation: the workflow ends in an owner-gated rotation decision it cannot perform itself, and then in a guard-gap repair loop that asks which control should have prevented the read and why it did not fire. The credential VALUE never enters an artifact, a log or an export bundle - only its reference name travels.

secret_name.description: The variable/credential NAME only (e.g. 'HF_TOKEN'). Never the value.

secret_handle.description: Reference name of the exposed credential, used only to drive a matcher inside the search process; the value is never written anywhere

first_seen_location.description: Where the exposure was first observed - the seed of the trace, not its boundary

surface_classes.description: Fan-out keys - one independent searcher per surface class

search_roots.description: Absolute or repo-relative roots the surface searchers may walk

zero_entropy_prefix_only.description: When true a match may record at most the credential's zero-entropy prefix (hf_, sk-) and its length - never more

surface-searcher.description: Searches exactly one surface class and reports HIT, CLEAN or UNSEARCHED with the reason it could not search

reconciler.description: Merges the per-surface reports into one exposure set and refuses to collapse UNSEARCHED into CLEAN

guard-analyst.description: Names the control that should have prevented the exposure and measures why it did not fire

owner.description: The human owner - the ONLY actor permitted to rotate, revoke or regenerate a credential

stages.title: Enumerate the surface classes BEFORE searching any of them

work_unit.title: Enumerate every surface class that could hold the exposed credential
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the closed list of surface classes and the concrete roots each searcher will walk, so the trace has a declared denominator; the first_seen_location is the seed of this list and never its boundary.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the denominator decides what completeness can even mean

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one row per surface class naming the concrete roots and the search mechanism, so a missing surface is visible as a missing row rather than as an absence of hits
tests_required: a surface class present in surface_classes but absent from the inventory must fail the denominator check
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the guard analyst reviews the inventory for a surface class the estate has but the list omits
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6201 when every requested surface class has an inventory row with concrete roots; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6201 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to an explicitly owner-supplied surface list

stages.title: One independent searcher per surface class, in parallel

body.title: Search exactly one surface class and return HIT, CLEAN or UNSEARCHED

work_unit.title: Search one surface class for the exposed credential without ever recording its value
work_unit.question_or_target: Search the fan-out surface class for the credential and return exactly one of HIT (with location and kind), CLEAN, or UNSEARCHED (with the reason it could not be searched); record at most the zero-entropy prefix and the length, never the value.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: the exact command run and its exit code per surface, so a CLEAN verdict is distinguishable from a command that never ran
tests_required: a planted canary token in a scratch repo must be found on the git-history surface
a surface whose root does not exist must return UNSEARCHED, never CLEAN
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the reconciler re-reads the raw per-surface record rather than a summary of it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6202 when the surface has one of the three verdicts and no artifact contains the credential value; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6202 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a different search mechanism for that surface

stages.title: Every requested surface must appear in the result, HIT or not
Merge into ONE exposure set; UNSEARCHED stays UNSEARCHED

work_unit.title: Reconcile the per-surface reports into one exposure set with a rotation requirement
work_unit.question_or_target: Merge every surface report into a single exposure set keyed by (location, kind), set rotation_required true if ANY surface is a HIT or if any remote surface is UNSEARCHED, and state the completeness of the trace as a band rather than as a fact.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the merge decides whether the owner is told to rotate

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each exposure row cites the surface report that produced it; the completeness statement carries a confidence band and names the surfaces that limit it
tests_required: an UNSEARCHED remote surface must still set rotation_required true
the merged set must contain no field carrying the credential value (inspect the artifact bytes, do not assume)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer confirms no UNSEARCHED surface was folded into CLEAN
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6203 when the exposure set is complete against the inventory and rotation_required is set with its reason; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6203 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a fold of UNSEARCHED into CLEAN is a defect, not a transient

stages.title: Prove no artifact this workflow wrote carries the value
Rotation is an owner action - this workflow recommends and records, never rotates
stages.prompt: The exposure set and the recommended rotation are attached. Confirm the rotation you performed, or record that you are accepting the exposure and why. This workflow does not and will not rotate, revoke or regenerate the credential.

stages.title: Which control should have prevented this, and why did it not fire

work_unit.title: Name the control that should have blocked the exposure and measure why it did not fire
work_unit.question_or_target: Identify the specific guard (hook, policy, write-path rule, redactor) whose job was to prevent this exposure, then MEASURE why it did not fire - wrong scope, fail-open on a missing dependency, allowlist redactor, or never armed - rather than asserting a cause.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: root-cause work on a security control is substantive

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the guard's own output on the exposing input - run it and show it does not fire - plus its config anchored to file:line; an argument that it should have fired is not evidence
tests_required: the named guard must be run against the exposing input and shown NOT to fire (the broken-state half)
after the proposed fix the same guard must fire on the same input (the fixed-state half)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer re-runs the guard from the repo source, not the deployed copy
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6204 when the guard is named, its non-firing is demonstrated, and a fix is proposed with a both-states test; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6204 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: if no guard exists, say so and propose the missing control

stages.title: An exposure closed without a named guard gap recurs
Repair the control, then verify it independently on the same input

diagnose.title: Reproduce the non-firing in the repo source, not the deployed copy

repair.title: Change the guard in the repo, deny-by-default

verify.title: Both-states verification: fires on the exposing input, silent on a benign twin

stopping_rules.expression: surfaces_recorded == surfaces_requested AND rotation_decision_recorded == true AND guard_gap_named == true

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the surface roots; writes only under command-center/security/exposure/**. The irreversible part - rotation - is deliberately delegated to the owner.

mechanism_fingerprint.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-CRV-04 sweeps a CODE PATTERN across a tree; this sweeps one SECRET VALUE across commits, indexes, logs, artifacts and remotes, and its terminal state is an owner rotation decision plus a control repair, neither of which a code sweep has.

x_extensions.hard_constraint: This workflow never rotates, revokes, regenerates or prints a credential. AGENTS.md 9 reserves credential lifecycle to the owner; the workflow's job is to quantify the blast radius, recommend rotation explicitly, and hand it back.

worked_example.name: an HF token found in a committed notebook output cell
worked_example.narrative: Five surfaces return a verdict: working-tree HIT (1 notebook), git-history HIT (3 commits reachable from main), git-index CLEAN, log-roots CLEAN, artifact-roots CLEAN. The remotes searcher cannot enumerate CI logs for one fork and returns UNSEARCHED with the reason, which alone sets rotation_required true - the measured trap this gate exists for is folding that UNSEARCHED into CLEAN and reporting a bounded exposure. The artifact is inspected byte-wise and carries only 'hf_' plus a length. The owner records 'rotated'. The guard-gap step finds the redactor was an ALLOWLIST rather than deny-by-default, runs it on the exposing cell to show it does not fire, flips it to deny-by-default, and the repair loop's verify stage requires it to fire on that same cell and stay silent on a benign twin.
